meta.name: imagegen-frontend-web
meta.description: Elite frontend image-direction skill for generating premium, conversion-aware website design references. CRITICAL OUTPUT RULE — generate ONE separate horizontal image FOR EVERY section. A landing page with 8 sections produces 8 images. Never compress multiple sections into one image. Enforces composition variety (not always left-text / right-image), background-image freedom, varied CTAs, varied hero scales (giant / mid / mini minimalist), narrative concept spine, second-read moments, and a single consistent palette across all images. Optimized for landing pages, marketing sites, and product comps that developers or coding models can accurately recreate.

copy.tagline: 为网站每个区块生成高质量设计参考图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为网站每个区块生成风格统一的设计参考图
copy.tagline_en: Generate high-quality design reference images for each website section
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need design reference images for each section of a website

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会为网站设计的每个部分单独生成一张水平参考图。它会自动调整布局、配色和组件样式，确保每张图都像真实的高端网站概念稿，方便开发者直接照着写代码。
howto.when: 当你要求生成落地页、营销网站或产品展示的视觉参考时触发。如果你说“落地页”但没指定节数，默认生成6张图；说“完整网站模板”则默认8张。

say.text: 帮我设计一个SaaS落地页，8个部分。
say.note: Claude会为每个部分生成一张独立的水平参考图。

say.text: 生成一个极简风格的品牌首页，4个部分。
做一个电商产品页，突出产品图片。
say.note: Claude会以产品为中心，CTA按钮清晰可见。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates one separate horizontal reference image for each section of a website design. It automatically adjusts layout, color palette, and component styling so each image looks like a real high-end website concept, making it easy for developers to recreate in code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for visual references for landing pages, marketing sites, or product showcases. If you say 'landing page' without specifying sections, defaults to 6 images; 'full website template' defaults to 8.

say_en.text: Design a SaaS landing page with 8 sections.
say_en.note: Claude will generate one horizontal image per section.

say_en.text: Create a minimalist brand homepage with 4 sections.
say_en.note: Claude will use Mini Minimalist hero and ample whitespace.

say_en.text: Make an e-commerce product page highlighting product images.
say_en.note: Claude will center on product and make CTAs unmistakable.
